verses.verse:
धैवतात्तु निषादस्य शुदस्य यावती मितिः।
तन्मानेन षड्जादूर्घ्वम् रिषभ इष्यते।।२८।।
verses.text: By the measure from Dhaivata to śuddha Niṣāda, Ṛṣabha is wanted above Ṣaḍja.

commentary.text: That is, at whatever distance śuddha Niṣāda lies from śuddha Dhaivata, Ṛṣabha's place is at that same height above Sa.
